## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record whether a [`gmeow:Honorific`](../classes/gmeow-Honorific.md) is rendered before (prefix) or after (suffix) the name — so the projection layer places the title correctly (Dr before, -san after).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the honorific's social domain (that is [`gmeow:honorificClass`](gmeow-honorificClass.md)) and avoid a free-text position — reference [`gmeow:honorificPositionPrefix`](../individuals/gmeow-honorificPositionPrefix.md) or [`gmeow:honorificPositionSuffix`](../individuals/gmeow-honorificPositionSuffix.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:honorificPosition`](gmeow-honorificPosition.md) once per [`gmeow:Honorific`](../classes/gmeow-Honorific.md) (functional) to a [`gmeow:HonorificPosition`](../classes/gmeow-HonorificPosition.md) individual; renderers read it to place the title around the name.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:honorificSan`](../individuals/gmeow-honorificSan.md) [`gmeow:honorificPosition`](gmeow-honorificPosition.md) [`gmeow:honorificPositionSuffix`](../individuals/gmeow-honorificPositionSuffix.md).
